request.style: English, male vocal, solo with ethereal choir, piano, cello, flute, ambient pads, haunting and majestic, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
A vision came in the third year's reign
Beside the Ulai canal I remained
I saw a ram with two horns long
One longer than the other, strong
It charged west and north and south
No beast could stand its power, no doubt
It did as it pleased and grew
Great in the eyes of the few

[Chorus]
A goat came from the west, flying high
Crossing the earth without touching the sky
A horn between its eyes, conspicuous and bright
It struck the ram in furious might
The ram fell down and was trampled underfoot
Rescued from none, the ram was lost

[Verse]
The goat grew great in power and might
But at the peak, the large horn broke and died
Four horns rose up toward the winds of heaven
Replacing the one that had been taken
Out of one came a small horn, growing
Toward the south and east, forever flowing
It reached the host of heaven above
Throwing stars down, trampled in love

[Chorus]
A goat came from the west, flying high
Crossing the earth without touching the sky
A horn between its eyes, conspicuous and bright
It struck the ram in furious might
The ram fell down and was trampled underfoot
Rescued from none, the ram was lost

[Bridge]
A holy one asked how long it would take
For the vision of the daily sacrifice to break
He answered with two thousand three hundred days
Then the sanctuary will be restored in ways
Gabriel stood before me, I was afraid
He spoke of the time of the end, unswayed
The ram was Media and Persia's crown
The goat was Greece, the king found

[Chorus]
A goat came from the west, flying high
Crossing the earth without touching the sky
A horn between its eyes, conspicuous and bright
It struck the ram in furious might
The ram fell down and was trampled underfoot
Rescued from none, the ram was lost

[Outro]
The vision is sealed for the distant future
I was worn out and ill for a measure
